title: Pricing & Billing | Sentry Docs
snippet:
Sentry offers a 14 day free trial with unlimited event data on the Business plan. You can upgrade or return to the features and quotas included with your existing plan. Without a paid plan, you will be automatically assigned a free Developer plan at the end of your trial.
Every paid plan includes a preset volume of event data, with a PAYG bugdet that you control. The free Developer plan has similar presets. See Sentry's [plan page](https://sentry.io/pricing/) for more details.

Sentry has one free Developer plan and three paid plans: Team, Business, and Enterprise. You can find more information about each by going to our [pricing page](https://sentry.io/pricing/).
Plan upgrades take effect immediately. Plan downgrades and cancellations are processed at the end of the current contract cycle and cannot be refunded. If you no longer want to be on a paid plan, you'll revert to the base Developer plan at the end of your current contract.
All new Sentry accounts come with a 14-day free trial period. You'll have the option to upgrade and continue to use Sentry's paid features at any time before your trial ends. Upgrades will be effective immediately. Users who haven't upgraded by the end of their free trial will return to the features and quotas included with their existing plan.

**Free accounts**
Free accounts will be able to request a one-time product trial at any time.

title: Pricing: Free Developer Plan, Pay as You Grow
snippet:
Each plan includes a base quota. Any usage above your quota is billed at pay-as-you-go rates. You only pay for what you use.

This calculator provides an estimate only. Your actual bill may differ due to rounding. Volumes above the slider maximums are supported on pay-as-you-go plans. Annual and prepaid billing options with additional discounts are available during checkout.

Developer is 0 USD a month for one user: 5,000 errors, 5 GB of logs, 5 GB of metrics, 5 M spans, 50 replays, one uptime monitor, one cron monitor, 20 metric monitors, 1 GB of attachments, 100 size analysis builds, 10 dashboards and a 30 day lookback. title: Sentry pricing (2026): what a small team actually pays
snippet:
Sentry's Developer plan is free for one user with 5,000 errors a month. Team is $26 a month billed yearly ($29 monthly), Business $80 ($89), both with unlimited users and the same included volume. The bill grows with errors, spans, replays and Seer at $40 per contributor. For 1 to 10 developers, Team plus a pay-as-you-go budget covers most apps.

## Is Sentry free? The Developer plan
Yes, for one person. The Developer plan costs $0 with no time limit. It includes error monitoring and tracing, email alerts, release health, 10 custom dashboards and MCP access, with **5,000 errors**, 5 million spans and 50 replays a month and a 30-day lookback. New accounts start on a **14-day Business trial** without a credit card and drop to Developer when it ends unless they upgrade. Each product, such as replays, can also be trialled once for 14 days with unlimited volume.
### Free plan limits
- **One user.** A second developer needs Team.
- No pay-as-you-go budget. Sentry offers the budget on paid plans only, so error number 5,001 in a month is dropped until the cycle resets.
- No API or third-party integrations, so alerts go by email instead of Slack.
- No profiling, which needs a pay-as-you-go budget.
